voices.text: Oh! Mind the puddles, little one.
Good morning! Have you heard the springs?
Hoo-hoo! A red hat! Welcome, welcome.
Tra-la! Off on an adventure, are we?
Shh, listen... can you hear the bubbles?
Hello, hello! Lovely day for fizzing.
Oh! Mind the puddles, little one.
Good morning! Have you heard the springs?
Hoo-hoo! A red hat! Welcome, welcome.
Hello there! Let's go and find the springs.
Hmph! Who goes poking at my lids?

npcs.name: Grandpa Femble
npcs.backstory: Grandpa Femble was born in Mossunder during the First Harvest. Years ago Grandpa Femble saw the guardians pass overhead. Now Grandpa Femble hopes the spirits will return to Fizzwater Caverns. Few know that Grandpa Femble once saw the hooded traveller.

npcs.name: Granny Pawick
npcs.backstory: Granny Pawick was born in Mossunder during the Sealing. Years ago Granny Pawick watched the harvest fail. Now Granny Pawick hopes the spirits will return to Toadstool Wood. Few know that Granny Pawick keeps a page of an old spell book.

npcs.name: Master Timble
npcs.backstory: Master Timble has kept the same house in Mossunder all their life. Years ago Master Timble saw the guardians pass overhead. Now Master Timble hopes the spirits will return to Mistcap Marsh. Few know that Master Timble keeps a page of an old spell book.

npcs.name: Little Toffle
npcs.backstory: Little Toffle was born in Mossunder during the Founding of the Monastery. Years ago Little Toffle watched the harvest fail. Now Little Toffle wishes to visit the monastery once more. Few know that Little Toffle is afraid of the sealed door.

npcs.name: Auntie Luddock
npcs.backstory: Auntie Luddock came to Toadstool Wood as a child. Years ago Auntie Luddock lost a brother on the road to Toadstool Wood. Now Auntie Luddock hopes the spirits will return to Toadstool Wood. Few know that Auntie Luddock once saw the hooded traveller.

npcs.name: Uncle Plupkin
npcs.backstory: Uncle Plupkin came to Fizzwater Caverns as a child. Years ago Uncle Plupkin lost a brother on the road to Fizzwater Caverns. Now Uncle Plupkin wishes to visit the monastery once more. Few know that Uncle Plupkin is afraid of the dark woods.

npcs.backstory: Mistress Guck came to Toadstool Wood as a child. Years ago Mistress Guck watched the harvest fail. Now Mistress Guck wants to see Toadstool Wood safe again. Few know that Mistress Guck keeps a page of an old spell book.
